messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: Unable to run any map-reduce program
parts:
It seems you have multiple versions of rmr installed. That function that causes the error changed signature many versions ago. All those package load failures are not necessarily a problem. If you don't need them in the map or reduce function you can ignore the messages or detach the packages before calling mapreduce, if you need them you need to install them on the nodes. But that's not the problem here, the problem is a version mismatch in rmr2.


Antonio

On Wednesday, August 6, 2014 10:32:01 PM UTC-7, Antonio Piccolboni wrote:
It seems you have multiple versions of rmr installed. That function that causes the error changed signature many versions ago. All those package load failures are not necessarily a problem. If you don't need them in the map or reduce function you can ignore the messages or detach the packages before calling mapreduce, if you need them you need to install them on the nodes. But that's not the problem here, the problem is a version mismatch in rmr2.


Antonio
